notes: Fixed Rush followers being unable to attack the enemy leader after their first turn, hardened the result screen against a lingering crash, and added a rewards summary to the result screen.
fixes: Fixed Rush followers being permanently blocked from attacking the enemy leader — the restriction was meant to apply only on the turn they were summoned, not for the rest of the match.
Hardened the victory/defeat result screen against a lingering crash caused by leftover damage-popup and speech-bubble effects trying to run after the match scene had already changed.
features: The result screen now shows a REWARDS EARNED summary (gold, packs, and any unlocks) above the PLAY AGAIN / RETURN TO MAIN MENU buttons whenever a win actually earns something.
upcoming_events: More seasonal content and cards are in development — check back after future updates for details.
